title: Second Chances (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Joris is a frustrated man who spends his days doing a job he hates and caring for his elderly mother. One day, he meets a dog, quickly becomes attached to it and decides to get back to his passion, biology, and to teach at university. It is a daunting task, and Joris sets himself the challenge of passing the exam to become a lecturer, but he has to face his brother, reluctant professors, and his own inner struggles.

synopsis_lang.en: Joris is a frustrated man who spends his days doing a job he hates and caring for his elderly mother. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Joris是一個失意的人，不但每天做著不喜歡的工作，還要照顧年邁的母親。某天，他遇到一隻狗，很快與牠建立了感情，並決定重拾自己對生物學的熱情，回到大學教書。為完成這項艱巨的目標，Joris決心挑戰講師資格考試，卻必須面對兄長的阻撓、態度猶疑的教授，以及自己內心的掙扎。

cast: François Civil, Karim Leklou, Léa Drucker, Miou-Miou
